name: Baltimore (United States)
description: The black-and-gold paly-bendy of the Calvert arms, charged at the centre with a black-and-white medallion of the Battle Monument.
history: Adopted in 1914 for the centennial of the Battle of Baltimore; the Calvert colours come from Maryland's founding family.

features.role: paly-bendy counterchanged black and gold (Calvert arms)

features.symbolism: the 1815 monument to the defenders of Baltimore in 1814
